properties.name: SGP4 Propagation v1
properties.description: Derives ISS geodetic position (WGS-84) from NORAD orbital elements using the Simplified General Perturbations Model 4 (SGP4). Input: OMM/TLE element set + target UTC epoch. Output: lat_deg, lon_deg, alt_km, velocity_km_s. Uses WGS-72 gravity model with iterative geodetic conversion. TLE source: CelesTrak OMM JSON endpoint. Reference implementation: python-sgp4 (Brandon Rhodes). See: https://celestrak.org/NORAD/documentation/gp-data-formats.php
